description: Baseline hashes for the Phase C regression gate, after the holdout pin and the window-end clamp. Verify with: python tools/verify_reproducibility.py
supersedes_reason: Two baseline files is the ambiguity the pinning exercise existed to end. The retired file hashed PRE-EXTENSION artifacts (data_end 2026-04-30) with truncated 16-hex digests, and those artifacts no longer exist on disk, so it could never pass -- while its presence left open which of the two was the gate.

config_that_produced_these._why_recorded: config.HOLDOUT_PIN_START defaults to None on main, which is NOT the value these artifacts were produced under. A fresh sweep at the default derives the boundary as data_end - 3 months, places the final window differently, and will not reproduce these hashes. Recording the producing config makes that divergence a checkable fact rather than something a reader must infer from a review document.

not_hashed.holdout_verdict.json: Regenerated by tools/holdout_test.py, which is analysis over summary.parquet rather than a sweep product. It legitimately changes when the holdout analysis is corrected -- as it did when the bootstrap CI pairing was repaired -- while the sweep artifacts above stay fixed. Hashing it would make an analysis fix look like a data regression.
